utterance: Hi Chloe, thanks for coming in. I'm sorry you're dealing with this — burning when passing urine is really uncomfortable. Before we decide on treatment, I'd like to ask a few questions to make sure we get it right. Can you tell me in your own words what's been happening since yesterday?
reply: It started yesterday morning, so about a day and a half ago. It stings and burns, and it is worst right at the end of going to the toilet. I am going constantly, about every half hour, and have to rush, but only a little bit comes out. It is a bit cloudy and smells, though I have not seen any blood.
